crossRefs.note: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the…
When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made…
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and…
through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
For of him, and through him, and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
translations.bsb: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
translations.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
translations.asv: Symeon hath rehearsed how first God visited the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
